thesis: The speakers discuss the nature of models as imperfect metaphors that capture only a portion of underlying truth, illustrated by the analogy of an acre versus a football field. They explore how the host's academic dissonance regarding stock market distributions led to a career in risk management and machine learning, driven by a desire to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world application.
